name: Ore-sama Kingdom ~Koi mo Manga mo Debut o Mezase! DokiDoki Love Lesson~
original_name: オレ様キングダム～恋もマンガもデビューを目指せ！ ドキドキLOVEレッスン～
source:
The story centers on Nonoha Nonohara, a young manga artist who just enrolled in a new school. She finds herself surrounded by a group of three "super-cute" guys.

(Source: MU)

An otome adaptation of the Ciao manga of the same name.
translation:
故事围绕刚进入新学校的年轻漫画家野原野乃叶展开。她被三名“超可爱”男孩包围。

改编自Ciao同名漫画。

[来源：MU]
